title: I gave my game launcher an OS look, with loads of functions and games to play and build on.

selftext: Think this is dumb, wait til you see what ChatSpace can do when it receives its final update lol. stay tuned because its going to be public once its ready.

Sounds cool.

Is every game on the desktop playable? And which game is running in the screenshot?

replies.body: yeah all of them I been working on since last year. and the game running is gravity block aka block busters lol. its a knockoff of smash bros but u can pick up blocks and throw them at people, and a boss spawns in once in a while, killing the boss respawns the dead players and turns the current winner into the next boss
